pairs.target: mǐlā zài chuāng biān děng de búshì tǎ wéi , érshì yì hú chíchí bù kāi de shuǐ .
pairs.english: What Mira waited for by the window was not Tavi, but a kettle of water that refused to boil.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉在窗边等的不是塔维，而是一壶迟迟不开的水。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tú dìguòqù , tā xiān kàn sìgè jiǎo , zài bǎ zhǐ fānguòlái , quèrèn méiyǒu zhān shàng tiěxiè , cái yāhuí shū lǐ .
pairs.english: He handed over the drawing; she checked all four corners first, turned the paper over, made sure no iron filings had stuck, then pressed it back into her book.
pairs.hanzi: 他把图递过去，她先看四个角，再把纸翻过来，确认没有沾上铁屑，才压回书里。

pairs.target: " lǎoshī zěnme shuō ? "
pairs.english: “What did the instructor say?”
pairs.hanzi: “老师怎么说？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gàosù tā , wéi lǎoshī kànguò tú , jīnrì què méiyǒu zhuāngwán mù zuò .
pairs.english: Tavi told her Instructor Vey had seen the drawing, but they hadn't finished assembling the wooden seat today.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维告诉她，维老师看过图，今日却没有装完木座。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhèng bǎ hú wǎng lú kǒu nuó , tīngdào zhèlǐ , tíngxià shǒu , wèn shìbushì yòu kǎzhù le .
pairs.english: Mira was moving the kettle toward the stove opening; hearing this, she stopped and asked whether it had jammed again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉正把壶往炉口挪，听到这里，停下手，问是不是又卡住了。

pairs.target: " shì wǒ jiàotíng de . "
pairs.english: “I called a stop.”
pairs.hanzi: “是我叫停的。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè jiěshì wèishénme , děng zhe tā zài wèn .
pairs.english: He didn't explain why immediately, waiting for her to ask again.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有立刻解释为什么，等着她再问。

pairs.target: mǐlā què zhǐ shuō zhīdào le , jiào tā bāngmáng bǎ chuāng tuīkāi yìdiǎn , lú yān bùkěn wǎng yāndào lǐ zǒu .
pairs.english: But Mira only said she understood and asked him to help open the window a little; the stove smoke refused to go up the flue.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉却只说知道了，叫他帮忙把窗推开一点，炉烟不肯往烟道里走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèng le yíxià , qǐshēn qù kāichuāng .
pairs.english: Tavi froze for a moment, then got up to open the window.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维怔了一下，起身去开窗。

pairs.target: fēng guànjìnlái , bǎ guà zài qiángbiān de jǐzhāng fèizhǐ chuī de luàn xiǎng , tā máng yòng wǎn yāzhù .
pairs.english: Wind rushed in; the scraps of waste paper hanging by the wall rattled noisily, and she quickly weighted them with a bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 风灌进来，把挂在墙边的几张废纸吹得乱响，她忙用碗压住。

pairs.target: " búshì ràng nǐ quán dǎkāi ! "
pairs.english: “I didn't ask you to open it all the way!”
pairs.hanzi: “不是让你全打开！”

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn lā huí bànshàn , húgài yě zài zhèshí tiào le yíxià , mǐlā ná bù tíqǐ hú , wǎng liǎngzhī bēizi lǐ dǎoshuǐ .
pairs.english: He hurriedly pulled half the window back; just then the lid jumped once, and Mira lifted the kettle with a cloth to pour water into two cups.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧拉回半扇，壶盖也在这时跳了一下，米拉拿布提起壶，往两只杯子里倒水。

pairs.target: yìzhī gěi tā , lìngyìzhī liúzài zìjǐ shǒubiān .
pairs.english: One was for him; she kept the other beside her own hand.
pairs.hanzi: 一只给他，另一只留在自己手边。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi tā tīng wán liànxí de shì huì shuō diǎn shénme , méixiǎngdào hái děi zìjǐ kāikǒu .
pairs.english: He thought she would say something after hearing about the practice, never expecting he'd still have to speak himself.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为她听完练习的事会说点什么，没想到还得自己开口。

pairs.target: " wǒ nàshí zǒng juéde , zhǐ chà zuìhòu yìdiǎn , zài chēngzhù jiù hǎo le . "
pairs.english: “I kept thinking then: only the last little bit left, just hold on a little longer.”
pairs.hanzi: “我那时总觉得，只差最后一点，再撑住就好了。”

pairs.target: mǐlā chuī le chuīshuǐ , shuō tā shàngwǔ yě tīngjiàn chàbùduō dehuà , búguò shìcóng zìjǐ zuǐlǐ chūlái de .
pairs.english: Mira blew on her water and said she'd heard much the same thing that morning, except it had come from her own mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉吹了吹水，说她上午也听见差不多的话，不过是从自己嘴里出来的。

pairs.target: tā náchū xīn huà de jiù jiàn pōu tú , biānshàng duō le yìquān hóngbǐ , búshì lǎoshī tì tā xiūhǎo de chǐcùn , érshì yígè hěndà de wènhào .
pairs.english: She produced the newly drawn section drawing of the old part, with a circle in red pen at the edge: not dimensions the instructor had corrected for her, but a very large question mark.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿出新画的旧件剖图，边上多了一圈红笔，不是老师替她修好的尺寸，而是一个很大的问号。

pairs.target: tā huà le zhóutào hé mù zuò , què méiyǒu liúxià bǎ jiù jiàn chāichūlái de wèizhì .
pairs.english: She had drawn the bushing and wooden seat, but left no space for removing the old part.
pairs.hanzi: 她画了轴套和木座，却没有留下把旧件拆出来的位置。

pairs.target: lǎoshī wèn tā , nándào xiàcì huài le , jiù lián pángbiān de hǎo mùtou yìqǐ sònglái .
pairs.english: The instructor asked her whether, if it broke next time, she'd send the good wood beside it along as well.
pairs.hanzi: 老师问她，难道下次坏了，就连旁边的好木头一起送来。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō dāngshí hěn xiǎng huídá , zhìshǎo xiān ràng tā yòng qǐlái .
pairs.english: Mira said she'd badly wanted to answer then: at least get it working first.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说当时很想回答，至少先让它用起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànkàn tā , yòu kànkàn nà zhāng tú , zhōngyú xiào le .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at her, then at the drawing, and finally laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看看她，又看看那张图，终于笑了。

pairs.target: tā bǎ tú shōuhuí qù , shuō bùxǔ xiào tàijiǔ , xiàwǔ háiyào gǎi .
pairs.english: She put the drawing away, saying he mustn't laugh too long; it still needed revising that afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 她把图收回去，说不许笑太久，下午还要改。

pairs.target: " nǐ kànjiàn nǎbiān chāi de chūlái le ma ? "
pairs.english: “Did you see which side it could be removed from?”
pairs.hanzi: “你看见哪边拆得出来了吗？”

pairs.target: " méi kànjiàn , wǒ yòu méi bǎ zhēnde chāiguò . "
pairs.english: “No, I didn't, and I haven't dismantled the real one.”
pairs.hanzi: “没看见，我又没把真的拆过。”

pairs.target: tā dá de gāncuì , dào ràng tā bùzhī zěnme jiē .
pairs.english: She answered crisply, unexpectedly leaving him unsure how to respond.
pairs.hanzi: 她答得干脆，倒让他不知怎么接。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , tā bǎ jīnrì tíngxià zhīqián shēntǐ wǎngqián nuó de shì shuōwán , yě shuō liǎngbiān huīfù yǐhòu cái chè shǒu .
pairs.english: A little later he finished telling how his body had moved forward before stopping today, and that he'd only lifted his hands after both sides recovered.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，他把今日停下之前身体往前挪的事说完，也说两边恢复以后才撤手。

pairs.target: mǐlā tīng zhe , méiyǒu tì tā bǎ shībài gǎichéng chénggōng , zhī wèn xiànzài shǒu hái nán bu nánshòu .
pairs.english: Mira listened without turning his failure into success for him, only asking whether his hands still felt uncomfortable now.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉听着，没有替他把失败改成成功，只问现在手还难不难受。

pairs.target: tā yáotóu , mōlemō bēi bì , shuō méiyǒu , zhǐshì yǒudiǎn diūliǎn .
pairs.english: He shook his head, felt the cup and said no, just a little embarrassed.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头，摸了摸杯壁，说没有，只是有点丢脸。

pairs.target: " nàjiùhǎo . "
pairs.english: “That's good, then.”
pairs.hanzi: “那就好。”

pairs.target: tā zhǐ de shì shǒu , tǎ wéi tīngdechūlái .
pairs.english: She meant his hands, Tavi could tell.
pairs.hanzi: 她指的是手，塔维听得出来。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén hē le yízhèn shuǐ , shuí yě méi jí zhe bǎ huà shuō yuán .
pairs.english: They drank water for a while; neither hurried to round off the conversation.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人喝了一阵水，谁也没急着把话说圆。

pairs.target: hòulái mǐlā bǎ qián jǐtiān bǎng guò xiàn de mùpiàn ná chūlái , huàn le yìgēn xì xiē de xiàn , zhǔnbèi kàn tóngyàng de wèizhì huì buhuì réngjiù dǎng shǒu .
pairs.english: Later Mira took out the wood they'd tied thread around a few days before, changed to a length of thinner thread and prepared to see whether the same position would still obstruct a hand.
pairs.hanzi: 后来米拉把前几天绑过线的木片拿出来，换了一根细些的线，准备看同样的位置会不会仍旧挡手。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn yào buyào ànzhe , tā shuō yào , dàn xiān bǎ bēizi ná yuǎn , bié ràng jiù yóu zhān dào shuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether he should hold it; she said yes, but first move the cups away so the old oil wouldn't get into the water.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问要不要按着，她说要，但先把杯子拿远，别让旧油沾到水里。

pairs.target: tā zhào zuò , zhècì méiyǒu tì tā juédìng bǎng nǎbiān .
pairs.english: He did so, this time without deciding for her which side to tie.
pairs.hanzi: 他照做，这次没有替她决定绑哪边。

pairs.target: ménwài yǒurén jiào tāmen , shuō yīwén zài lóuxià zhǎo yìzhī yán dié .
pairs.english: Someone called to them from outside, saying Iven was downstairs looking for a salt dish.
pairs.hanzi: 门外有人叫他们，说伊文在楼下找一只盐碟。

pairs.target: mǐlā kànkàn zhuōshàng de kōng dié , yòu kànkàn tǎ wéi , hūrán wèn zuótiān dàodǐ shì shuí bǎ diézi náshànglái de .
pairs.english: Mira looked at the empty dish on the table, then at Tavi, suddenly asking who had actually brought up the dish yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看看桌上的空碟，又看看塔维，忽然问昨天到底是谁把碟子拿上来的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ huílái de shíhòu yǐjīng zài le .
pairs.english: Tavi said it had been there already by the time he returned.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己回来的时候已经在了。

pairs.target: tā biàn cháo ménwài hǎn , shuō ràng yīwén lái ná , shùnbiàn dài kuài gānjìng bù .
pairs.english: She then called toward the door, telling Iven to come and collect it, and bring a clean cloth along.
pairs.hanzi: 她便朝门外喊，说让伊文来拿，顺便带块干净布。

pairs.target: " wèishénme yào bù ? "
pairs.english: “Why do you need a cloth?”
pairs.hanzi: “为什么要布？”

pairs.target: nà rén tì lóuxià wèn .
pairs.english: The messenger asked on behalf of those downstairs.
pairs.hanzi: 那人替楼下问。

pairs.target: mǐlā kànzhe lúbiān nà quān shuǐyìn , miànbùgǎisè dì dá , shuō diézi yǐjīng xuéhuì yóuyǒng le .
pairs.english: Mira looked at the ring of water by the stove, answered without a change of expression and said the dish had already learned to swim.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉看着炉边那圈水印，面不改色地答，说碟子已经学会游泳了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi rěnzhù , xiào de gāng ànzhù de mùpiàn yòu sōng le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't hold back; he laughed, loosening his hold on the wood a little again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没忍住，笑得刚按住的木片又松了一点。

pairs.target: mǐlā qiāoqiāo zhuōmiàn , tā biàn chóngxīn àn wěn , děng tā de zhǐjiān cóng xiàn jié páng mànmàn huáguòqù .
pairs.english: Mira tapped the table; he steadied it again and waited for her fingertip to slide slowly past the knot.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉敲敲桌面，他便重新按稳，等她的指尖从线结旁慢慢滑过去。
